hook: A 18.9 million dollar dispute is tearing apart two music giants.

sections.voiceover: A 18.9 million dollar dispute is tearing apart two music giants.
In 2018, AEG Presents filed a corporate lawsuit against Danny Wimmer Presents. Did their failed $18.9 million buy-sell offer for those festivals end their co-promotion partnership?
However, the conflict escalated when Danny Wimmer Presents launched the rival Sonic Temple Art + Music Festival.
Judges at the Stanley Mosk Courthouse will finally oversee a jury trial in February 2027. This legal battle between AEG Presents and Danny Wimmer Presents has now spanned 8 years.
The 8-year battle heads to trial in 2027.
